[[File:Kensuke Sato.jpg|thumb|250px|Kensuke Satō]] '''Kensuke Satō''' (Japanese: '''佐藤健輔''' ''Satō Kensuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==Biography== Satō was born sometime on May 14 in {{wp|Nagasaki Prefecture|Nagasaki}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started to work on Pokémon in {{aniseries|BW}}. His most notable roles are [[Ingo]], [[Iris's Dragonite]], and [[Clemont's Luxray]].
